title: Crispy {p} Breakfast Quesadilla with {v}
steps: Cook the {p} in a skillet over medium heat, scrambling any eggs and crumbling any sausage or bacon, until {doneness}. Move to a plate.
Cook the {v} in the same pan until soft.
Lay out the {s} and fill half of each with cheese, the {p} and the {v}, then fold over.
Cook in a lightly buttered skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and melted. Slice and serve with the {sauce}.
tip: Fill it with plenty of vegetables and eggs, and go lighter on the cheese and sausage.
